source.title: Reviewer consensus: Coffee Chronicler 15, Howchoo 12–14, Beanground 15
Honest Coffee Guide: Hario Mini Mill / Slim / Pro grind settings
source.notes: No reviewer gives a cold brew setting; Honest Coffee Guide's other rows run finer than reviewers', so treat the low end with caution.

procedure.en: Tighten the click nut at the base of the burr shaft fully clockwise. That is zero. Count clicks counter-clockwise from there.
procedure.pt-BR: Aperte a porca de cliques na base do eixo da mó totalmente no sentido horário. Esse é o zero. Conte os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali.

notes: Click nut at the base of the inner burr shaft. About 20 usable clicks from zero (Honest Coffee Guide charts to 20; coffeegrinderguide counts to 24). Hario's manuals give no click numbers. Mini Slim Plus, Mini Slim Pro and the original Mini Mill share the same chart on Honest Coffee Guide. Reviewer counts are used where Honest Coffee Guide is the outlier.
